name: Calming piano loop
author: Seth_Makes_Sounds
why: Solo piano at 60 BPM. The most sober option: nothing competes with the voice.
tradeoff: Little drive; the logo landing leans on the sound effects.

name: Calm background
author: Bertsz
why: Soft pads with a light pulse. Reads as a quiet, polished product film.
tradeoff: A weak beat, so hits land on the music's pulse less clearly.

name: Chill lo-fi e-piano
author: holizna
why: Warm lo-fi keys at 80 BPM. Feels like a late, relaxed dinner.
tradeoff: Loops every 24 s; a little sleepy for a call to action.

name: Chill background
author: Seth_Makes_Sounds
why: Relaxed modern groove with a soft beat. Easy under a voice.
tradeoff: Fairly anonymous; less personality than the recommended bed.

name: Simple relaxing guitar
author: Kodack
why: One acoustic guitar. Human and warm, fits a restaurant table.
tradeoff: No drums, so the beat grid is soft.

name: Blue sky ukulele
author: Sergmusic
why: Bright ukulele and a happy lift. Friendly and casual.
tradeoff: Can feel like a stock ad if overused.

name: Little happy tune
author: cabled_mess
why: Light, playful melody at 120 BPM: the same grid as the recommended bed.
tradeoff: Busy melody; it may fight the voice in shot 3.

name: Happy hip hop beat
author: Seth_Makes_Sounds
why: Confident head-nod groove. Strong beats for the taps and the logo.
tradeoff: Heavier drums; keep the voice well above it.

name: Funky groove
author: code_box
why: Funky bass and drums. Fun and lively.
tradeoff: Swingy feel; hits sit less tightly on the grid.

name: Beach dance
author: szegvari
why: Bright dance track at 120 BPM. Maximum energy.
tradeoff: Loud and busy; the least premium option.

name: Slow cinematic
author: DeVern
why: Slow, emotional swells. Turns the film into a short story.
tradeoff: No steady beat, so nothing snaps to a grid; feels heavy for a bill-splitting app.
